training.what: assets/trl_model.json: cumulative logistic regressions P(TRL >= k) for k = 6 and 7 over 23 case-level features (best evidence score and cue count per criterion kind, target type); assets/trl_prior.json: smoothed TRL distribution per target type.
training.code: dev/train_trl.py and dev/build_prior.py in the team repository
training.configuration: scikit-learn LogisticRegression, L2, C = 0.1, standardised features; add-0.5 smoothing for the prior
training.validation: leave-one-out over the 99 public cases (prior rebuilt without the held-out case): part-A proxy 0.778 prior only, 0.813 prior + evidence

data_sources.source: APCTT public sample cases (contracts/public-cases.json, USGS reports)
data_sources.role: development, tuning and validation; training targets of the TRL model and prior
data_sources.label_origin: organizer's estimated TRL per report and its one-sentence rationale; not expert labels
data_sources.license_note: U.S. public domain (USGS); some figures in the reports are third-party (see the manifest's licence_note); no report content is shipped

data_sources.source: Team-made criterion labels for 20 of the public sample cases (data/silver/ in the team repository)
data_sources.role: development and tuning of evidence rules and retrieval weights, and proxy scoring; not used to train the TRL model or shipped in the package
data_sources.label_origin: per-criterion status and gold pages drafted by the team with an AI assistant from the report text, 5 cases without seeing the pipeline's output; a team member spot-checked 3 cases; not expert labels

prompts_or_rules: assets/criteria_profiles.json (team-written cues, queries and NLI hypotheses keyed by criterion kind)
dependency_declarations: the common base environment (base_id in submission.json)
catalogue models listed in submission.json models[]

notes: No NASA TechPort data and no data from outside the public sample cases were used; the team-made labels above are derived from those cases.
